NATIONAL HERITAGE ACT 2005

NATIONAL HERITAGE (DECLARATION OF NATIONAL HERITAGE)

(HERITAGE SITE) ORDER 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 67(1) of

the National Heritage Act 2005 [Act 645], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the National Heritage (Declaration of National

Heritage) (Heritage Site) Order 2017.

National Heritage

2. The site described in columns (1), (2) and (3) of the Schedule that has been

designated as a heritage site as published in the Gazette described in column (4) and

listed in the Register is declared to be a National Heritage.
